items.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
items.summary: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation selects a preferred teacher for each token during training, improving mathematical reasoning performance over fixed-teacher methods.

items.title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
items.summary: Kierston and KierstonBench provide a simulated city-scale environment to evaluate large language models on criminal investigation tasks using linked surveillance records, revealing that only frontier models perform reliably while remaining vulnerable to deception.

items.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
items.summary: FactEmbed improves composed image retrieval by decoupling query understanding from embedding construction through factorized latents that simulate visual modifications before retrieval.

items.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.summary: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

items.title: You don't need long context
items.summary: Frequent context compaction preserves task accuracy across long-horizon and long-input tasks, suggesting that long-context language models may be unnecessary and motivating semantic state space models.

items.title: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
items.summary: GigaSpeech 3 provides 39,000 hours of weakly transcribed dialectal Arabic speech, enabling improved recognition across five dialects via self-supervised labeling and noisy-student refinement.

items.title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
items.summary: Using Muon to train mixture-of-experts language models increases routing imbalance in early layers, which can be mitigated by centering router inputs or reducing the optimizer learning rate.

items.title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
items.summary: An autonomous agent adaptively designs target-specific multiple sequence alignments for AlphaFold 3 by reasoning over biological hypotheses and self-directed experimentation, improving protein interface prediction with fewer sequences.

items.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
items.summary: Kev-Bio is a vision-language model that guides ultrasound landmark detection via clinical questions, generating spatial probability maps to derive measurements with reduced operator variability.

items.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
items.summary: DreamX leverages a pretrained video diffusion model to learn compact, appearance-invariant latent actions that enable cross-embodiment transfer and efficient policy learning.

items.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
items.summary: VidUEU-Agent automates instruction data synthesis from raw videos via a multi-stage pipeline with autonomous iteration, yielding a 100K-sample dataset that improves multimodal model performance.

items.title: Going Deeper With Memories
items.summary: DeepMem is a causal multiscale byte-level architecture that uses invertible subband transforms and fast weight memory to compress sequences for efficient reasoning while preserving exact byte identity via lossless carriers and attention-based super-resolution decoding.

items.title: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
items.summary: RoboTryOn translates human demonstration videos into robot videos to train control policies without real robot demonstrations, improving success rates and reducing data collection costs.

items.title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
items.summary: A benchmark for resuming interrupted software tasks reveals performance drops from interleaved work, and a context-management module improves recovery.

items.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
items.summary: EvoTeam evolves multi-agent collaboration by jointly adapting team organization, interaction rules, and agent skills through execution experience while maintaining reusable team libraries.

items.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
items.summary: FlowTranslator is a training-free framework for in-image machine translation that uses diffusion trajectory controls to generate accurate translated text within images without paired training data.

items.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: ToolSpace constructs realistic multi-environment tool-use benchmarks by mining execution traces, clustering tool compositions, and validating tasks through replayable state-aware random walks.

items.title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
items.summary: Typed decision models classify source-conflict types faster and cheaper than frontier LLMs, with cascades matching top accuracy at lower cost, though they vary in sensitivity and false-source detection.

items.title: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks
items.summary: DEPTH generates complex terminal tasks by measuring sequential dependency depth rather than turn count, producing harder benchmarks that improve agent fine-tuning.

items.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.summary: WebHarbor provides 153 executable, dockerized web environments for stable evaluation and reinforcement learning training of GUI agents, enabling strong generalization across multi-step and post-authentication tasks.

items.title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
items.summary: MoLRSI is an AI agent that optimizes molecular design workflows and retains cross-task memory to improve search policies, achieving higher experimental hit rates in antibiotic and peptide binder discovery than expert-led methods.

items.title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
items.summary: YANAMI introduces a large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, requiring models to track and realize evolving dialogue states across turns, and reveals that current unified multimodal models still struggle with this task.

items.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
items.summary: Pandora is a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models evolving psychological and relational states to generate more authentic, individually aligned expressions and reduce AI-like responses.

items.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.summary: Route Anything is a framework for dynamically selecting and coordinating specialized AI models and policies across diverse tasks to improve performance and efficiency.

items.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
items.summary: Axion 1.0 is an open agent foundation model trained via a concise three-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, achieving competitive agentic performance while fully releasing its data and training recipe.

items.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
items.summary: Caper pre-executes shell commands in isolated sandboxes to evaluate real-world effects before approval, reducing harmful outcomes compared to text-based approvers.

items.title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
items.summary: Comparing replacement operators for pruned mixture-of-experts experts reveals that gate scaling and calibration domain strongly affect performance, with a proposed tilted novice operator improving results without dominating all settings.

items.title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: Cross-pathway concept unlearning in unified multimodal models is addressed by a new benchmark and method that jointly suppresses target concept generation and recognition while preserving other capabilities.

items.title: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
items.summary: AI reviewers often fail to reflect manuscript improvements in scores, with user opinions frequently overriding observed revision gains.

items.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
items.summary: Frontier vision-language models vary widely in embodied task performance, with closed-weight systems leading in planning and manipulation while open-weight models lag, and failure patterns reveal distinct geometric, control, and reasoning errors rather than uniform deficits.

items.title: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: A retrieval-augmented generation system for stock market queries improves response accuracy and speed, validated by high ROUGE scores and low latency.

items.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.summary: Kling's multimodal understanding stack links caption density, perceptual text encoding, reward modeling, and evaluation protocols to improve controllable video generation.

items.title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
items.summary: Near-zero input embeddings in untied gated language models cause extreme gradient amplification and training instability, which is addressed by GroupClip and GateFloor remedies.

items.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
items.summary: LOLPlay evaluates visual agents on real-time League of Legends tasks, finding that increased reasoning effort does not improve success and can reduce interaction time.

items.title: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
items.summary: A two-stage adaptive framework improves multi-step GUI agent training by using intermediate checkpoints and selective rollout ranges to reduce environment interactions while boosting performance.

items.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.summary: PrimeSim is an action-conditioned multiview world model that uses progressive training, unified action representations, view-aware attention, and hierarchical memory to enable consistent, long-horizon robot simulation and policy optimization.

items.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary: Mage-VL-Cowork is a 4B hybrid computer-use agent trained via a progressive curriculum and scalable synthetic data generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on OSWorld-Verified with efficient reasoning.

items.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
items.summary: Recursa is a self-improving foundation model system that adapts to new domains by recursively learning from its own experience, storing skills and reflections in a knowledge repository, and validating improvements without human supervision or stronger teachers.

items.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
items.summary: SpecPilot autonomously discovers deployment-specific algorithms and system optimizations to maximize speculative decoding speedups across diverse models, drafters, and serving regimes without quality loss.

items.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
items.summary: ParetoSaddler improves LLM agent harnesses by separately promoting intermediate candidates via Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support and selecting final deployments, boosting quality while reducing cost.

items.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
items.summary: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for long-form multi-shot video editing that uses cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling and a new benchmark to maintain coherence across scenes while reducing manual data annotation.

items.title: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
items.summary: SeMo3D unifies 3D generation, editing, and completion through selective region modeling, using region-selective denoising and a multi-condition diffusion transformer to preserve unchanged content and enable training without paired data.

items.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
items.summary: RoboColosseum evaluates general robot policies across diverse embodiments and environments, revealing weak cross-embodiment agreement, limited open-world reliability, and substantial differences between zero-shot and fine-tuned performance.

items.title: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
items.summary: This monograph surveys neural methods for music audio generation, covering codecs, autoregressive and diffusion models, flow matching, preference optimization, evaluation practices, and legal considerations.

items.title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
items.summary: History Forcing improves long-range consistency in few-step autoregressive video generation by using historical context residuals to correct distillation targets.

items.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
items.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.

items.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Order-only on-policy distillation trains students to match teacher token rankings rather than probabilities, improving reasoning performance without temperature tuning.

items.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
items.summary: Layer-wise error modeling and token-wise Fisher statistics improve low-rank SVD compression of large language models by refining rank allocation and decomposition quality.

items.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
items.summary: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization improves long-context retrieval in gated linear recurrent models by jointly configuring decay and sensitivity parameters before training.

items.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
items.summary: DR Pixel is an open-source multimodal agent that performs deep research directly on rendered document page images, improving retrieval and reasoning over scientific papers through counterfactual credit reweighting.
